name: Mikuriya Reiko
source:
A doctor in the virginity department of a hospital. An erotic, beautiful doctor who constantly exudes a mature allure.

She’s a mysterious figure; even the nurses know nothing about her private life. Moans can always be heard coming from her office, and she even touches herself with one hand while seeing patients.

There are rumors that she wears a bondage outfit under her white coat. For some reason, she always collects more of her patients’ semen than necessary. It might take some patience to win her over.

[From [url=http://www.milkcrown.co.jp/hakudaku/dotei/dt_reiko.html]official site[/url]]
